## Summary

What changed and why? Link the issue and describe user-visible behavior.

## Verification

Provide commands/results, regression cases and sanitized screenshots where useful.

- [ ] `pnpm run lint`
- [ ] `pnpm run typecheck`
- [ ] `pnpm test`
- [ ] Relevant regression tests added, or reason not applicable explained

## Data and security impact

Describe changes to source rights, timestamps, authentication, tenant isolation, secrets, outbound requests or database migrations. State "none" where applicable.

## Documentation and limitations

- [ ] README / roadmap / relevant structural docs updated where behavior changed
- [ ] Changelog updated for delivered changes
- [ ] No credentials, private user data or restricted fixtures committed
- [ ] Remaining gaps and any rollout/migration steps are documented
